name: 85033 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85033 (Phoenix) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85033 (Phoenix) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85033 (Phoenix) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
